issue: Root README is placeholder or materially inadequate
operational_security_impact: Repository onboarding, setup, test, security, deployment, and disclosure boundaries remain undocumented at the root.
implementation_risk: Low if documentation stays factual; medium if README overclaims readiness, license, deployment, or production status.
recommended_disposition: Prepare documentation/metadata draft PR with root README replacement and non-secret environment examples.
runtime_behavior_impact: No runtime behavior impact for review package; docs draft PR is documentation-only.
tool_implications: No dependency, lockfile, CI, deployment, or scanner implication.
founder_decision_required: Founder review required for public/private disclosure posture and final README wording.
validation_requirements: Markdown review, non-overclaim check, git diff --check, CI unchanged.
rollback_requirements: Revert README and env-example documentation changes only.

issue: No repository-root license or explicit distribution policy exists
line_references: root tree absence check; no LICENSE, LICENSE.*, COPYING, or COPYING.* at reviewed commit
operational_security_impact: Distribution, reuse, contribution, and legal posture are ambiguous without Founder/legal disposition.
implementation_risk: High policy risk if Codex selects a license; no technical runtime risk from preserving no-license posture.
recommended_disposition: Document decision options only; do not add a LICENSE file or license grant.
tool_implications: No package, lockfile, CI, deployment, or scanner implication.
founder_decision_required: Yes. License selection or express proprietary/no-license posture is reserved.
validation_requirements: Verify no LICENSE file added and README does not grant open-source rights.
rollback_requirements: Remove unauthorized license text if introduced later.

issue: Backend requirements mix runtime and development/test tooling
operational_security_impact: Production install boundary is larger than necessary and CI currently installs one backend manifest for runtime plus test tooling.
implementation_risk: Medium. Moving only evidenced dev/test tools is low risk; moving transitive or startup-required packages without proof is not authorized.
recommended_disposition: Prepare backend dependency split draft PR only for clearly evidenced direct dev/test tools.
runtime_behavior_impact: Intended none; runtime requirements retain application imports and deployment behavior.
tool_implications: Adds backend/requirements-dev.txt and updates CI backend install steps to use dev manifest for tests.
founder_decision_required: Founder review before merge; no IWP activation.
validation_requirements: Backend collection/non-live tests in CI, requirements-dev includes runtime manifest, no package version changes.
rollback_requirements: Restore prior backend/requirements.txt and CI install lines; remove requirements-dev file.

issue: CI lacks dedicated lint, format, typing, SAST, dependency-audit, license-audit, and secret-scan evidence
operational_security_impact: Existing CI gives backend collectability, known-failure-gated tests, and frontend build, but does not surface separate static/dependency/secret/license assurance.
implementation_risk: Medium if new checks are blocking; lower if visibility-only and ratcheted.
recommended_disposition: Prepare CI-assurance draft PR with non-blocking reporting and Dependabot config; no external scanners.
tool_implications: GitHub Actions workflow and .github/dependabot.yml only; no branch-protection changes.
founder_decision_required: Founder must decide whether and when reports become blocking.
validation_requirements: Workflow syntax review, draft PR CI, no required-check or branch-protection changes.
rollback_requirements: Revert CI-assurance workflow additions and Dependabot config.

issue: Frontend installation relies on npm ci --legacy-peer-deps because of peer conflicts
operational_security_impact: Deterministic install depends on legacy peer handling; npm ls reports React 19 invalid against react-day-picker 8.10.1 peer range.
implementation_risk: High for dependency update without design because React/package compatibility and lockfile effects are intertwined.
recommended_disposition: Document plan only; do not create frontend dependency implementation PR.
runtime_behavior_impact: No runtime change under this directive.
founder_decision_required: Founder disposition required for React/package compatibility direction.
validation_requirements: Separate future npm install/build/regression evidence if authorized.
rollback_requirements: Revert any future package and lockfile changes if compatibility evidence fails.

issue: Large modules create maintainability and review-risk concentration
operational_security_impact: Large high-centrality files increase review and regression risk, especially around backlog, ledger, role intake, care ledger, and task orchestration.
implementation_risk: High if refactored without behavior-parity tests and domain sequencing.
tool_implications: No dependency, lockfile, CI, or deployment implication.
founder_decision_required: Yes, before any product-code refactor workstream.
validation_requirements: Future design must include boundaries, tests, rollback, and behavior parity.
rollback_requirements: Not applicable in this package; future refactor rollback would restore original module paths.

issue: Secret/API-key scan evidence is absent or incomplete
operational_security_impact: Ignore rules and frontend deployment docs identify secret boundaries, but no repository-local or CI secret-scan evidence was verified.
implementation_risk: Medium if scanner outputs values; this package records no secret candidate values.
recommended_disposition: Use CI-assurance draft PR for redacted pattern reporting only; no external scanner setup.
tool_implications: Local pattern report only; no scanner service or repository app configured.
founder_decision_required: Founder decision required for historical scan or GitHub/native scanner enablement.
validation_requirements: No secret values printed; redacted counts/locations only.
rollback_requirements: Remove reporting workflow/docs if scope expands or output policy is unsafe.

issue: No automated linter or type/style enforcement
operational_security_impact: Lint/type tools are declared, but current CI does not run dedicated lint/type jobs.
implementation_risk: Medium if made blocking against existing debt; low if report-only.
recommended_disposition: Treat as duplicate segment of CI assurance; do not double-count separate gap.
tool_implications: Workflow reporting only, using existing declared tools.
founder_decision_required: Founder decision required before blocking ratchet.
validation_requirements: Non-blocking output, no blanket exclusions, no clean-scan claim.

issue: Dependency lock, npm version, and deterministic-install concerns
operational_security_impact: npm audit reports dependency advisories and npm ls reports peer invalidity; package-lock size alone is not a defect.
implementation_risk: High if remediated through major dependency updates or broad lockfile regeneration.
recommended_disposition: Record dependency-monitoring need and future frontend plan; no dependency or lockfile change now.
tool_implications: CI-assurance reporting and Dependabot config only; no auto-merge or major-version acceptance.
founder_decision_required: Founder decision required for dependency update policy and React path.
validation_requirements: Audit report is evidence, not closure; no claim of clean dependency state.
rollback_requirements: Revert reporting config; future lockfile changes must be separately reversible.

operational_security_impact: Frontend Vercel deployment is documented; backend host/container model remains decision-dependent.
implementation_risk: High if Codex adds Docker or deployment config without intended deployment model.
recommended_disposition: Document existing frontend model and Founder decision need; do not change deployment config.
tool_implications: No Dockerfile, hosting config, or deployment script change authorized.
founder_decision_required: Yes, backend/container deployment model and docs scope.
proposed_pr_segment: PR1_DOCS_METADATA for factual docs links only; deployment config reserved
validation_requirements: Verify no deployment config change in docs PR beyond existing links.
rollback_requirements: Revert any docs wording that implies deployment authorization or changes config.
